groups.title: Real Estate Product
groups.meta: 17 mobile devs (10 VN, 7 Egypt & Thailand) · Direct client: Saudi Arabia
groups.stack: Modular Feature-Based Clean Architecture, Melos Monorepo, BLoC, Scrum, Kanban
bullets: Built and maintained features for a Saudi Arabian government client's real estate product; analysed BRDs with BA, backend and QC, agreed APIs, estimated tasks and demoed every epic to the client.
Built and maintained the design system library, participating in team peer code reviews.
Embedded Unity in Flutter for an in-app metaverse of buildings and events; integrated third-party SDKs.
Reduced app size from 200MB to 90MB and raised key screens from 30–40 FPS to a steady 60.
Optimised data-layer caching and migrated state management from Stream to BLoC.
Implemented SSL pinning and set up Adjust deferred deep links.

groups.title: Warehouse App for POS / Handheld Devices
groups.stack: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM, Clean Architecture
bullets: Built a warehouse management app for Unitech HT300/HT330 barcode devices, end to end.
Integrated the hardware scanner for live barcode capture; synced receipt, dispatch and inventory.
Built an offline-first data layer with periodic sync, so the floor kept working without a network.
Agreed barcode formats across teams; set up kiosk mode, auto-launch on boot and a private Play release.

groups.title: Cross-Platform Apps
bullets: Built apps from scratch and maintained existing ones: booking and health apps in React Native; a household appliance and apartment maintenance management app in Expo; e-learning, file management and apartment equipment apps in Flutter.
Wrote a native module for the health app to measure heart rate using the phone camera.
Implemented FCM push notifications, Firebase Crashlytics, and Firebase Analytics.
Set up CI/CD pipelines to build and release the apps.
Made the apps responsive on iPad, in portrait and landscape.
Led a sub-project with 3 members: planned sprints, estimated tasks and reviewed delivery.
